Now prices: set_price(model, cents_per_1k_tokens) sets a model's price and returns it. cost(key) is what that key has spent in dollars, rounded to cents. A model without a price costs nothing.

(define (set_price model cents_per_1k_tokens)
  (unless (and (string? model) (real? cents_per_1k_tokens) (>= cents_per_1k_tokens 0))
    (error 'set_price "model must be a string, price a non-negative number"))
  (let* ([s (get-state)]
         [ps (hash-ref s 'prices (hasheq))])
    (set-state! (hash-set s 'prices (hash-set ps (string->symbol model) cents_per_1k_tokens)))
    cents_per_1k_tokens))

(define (cost key)
  (let* ([s (get-state)]
         [cs (hash-ref s 'calls '())]
         [ps (hash-ref s 'prices (hasheq))]
         [usd (for/fold ([t 0]) ([c cs])
                (if (equal? (hash-ref c 'key) key)
                    (let ([p (hash-ref ps (string->symbol (hash-ref c 'model "")) #f)])
                      (if p (+ t (/ (* (hash-ref c 'tokens 0) p) 100000)) t))
                    t))])
    (/ (floor (+ (* usd 100) 1/2)) 100)))

Rate limits: set_quota(key, tokens) caps a key's total tokens and returns the quota; it throws if the key has already used more. record_usage must throw if the call would take the key over its quota. Keys without a quota are unlimited.

(define (set_quota key tokens)
  (unless (and (string? key) (real? tokens) (>= tokens 0))
    (error 'set_quota "key must be a string, quota a non-negative number"))
  (let* ([s (get-state)]
         [qs (hash-ref s 'quotas (hasheq))]
         [used (usage key)])
    (when (> used tokens)
      (error 'set_quota (format "key ~a already used ~a tokens, over quota" key used)))
    (set-state! (hash-set s 'quotas (hash-set qs (string->symbol key) tokens)))
    tokens))

(define (record_usage key model tokens)
  (unless (and (string? key) (string? model) (real? tokens) (>= tokens 0))
    (error 'record_usage "key and model must be strings, tokens a non-negative number"))
  (let* ([s (get-state)]
         [cs (hash-ref s 'calls '())]
         [qs (hash-ref s 'quotas (hasheq))]
         [q (hash-ref qs (string->symbol key) #f)])
    (when (and q (> (+ (usage key) tokens) q))
      (error 'record_usage (format "key ~a would exceed its quota" key)))
    (set-state! (hash-set s 'calls (append cs (list (hasheq 'key key 'model model 'tokens tokens))))))
  (usage key))
